question: Who won the 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, and what did they develop?
text:
**Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson, and Omar M. Yaghi** shared the 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing **metal–organic frameworks (MOFs)**. ([nobelprize.org](https://www.nobelprize.org/uploads/2025/10/press-chemistryprize2025.pdf?utm_source=openai))

MOFs are porous materials made by linking metal ions or clusters with organic molecules. Their tiny pores can be designed to capture specific molecules, making MOFs useful for applications such as capturing carbon dioxide and harvesting water from dry air. ([nobelprize.org](https://www.nobelprize.org/uploads/2025/10/press-chemistryprize2025.pdf?utm_source=openai))
